verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official CLI (npm package @hubspot/cli, initialized with `hs init`, which authorizes your account) for building on its Developer Platform. Its Developer MCP server wraps that CLI so agentic dev tools can scaffold and manage projects. The documented scope is limited to developer-platform project work, and there is no command reference or evidence of CRM data operations from the CLI. missing for 10: a documented CLI command reference covering CRM/data operations, evidence of machine-readable output or non-interactive automation for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the HubSpot CLI globally / Authorize your HubSpot account / Start building
The Developer MCP server enables your agentic development tools to interact with the HubSpot Developer Platform via the CLI.
This server is CLI-based and enables your agentic development software to interact with the HubSpot Developer Platform, helping you to quickly scaffold and manage your projects.
